pstack:reproduce-and-fix-issues.reason: Benny requires configured Slack, tracker, app control, and explicit message and PR authority.

pstack:setup-benny.reason: Benny service setup is outside the local personal stack.

pstack:triage-issue-reports.reason: Slack thread verdicts and tracker writes need a separately configured and authorized workflow.

pstack:arena.reason: Competing candidates can help selected design decisions, but fixed model panels and default fan-out conflict with Son's model policy.

pstack:make-bot-ui.reason: Requires bot webhooks, sender credentials, hosting, and tailnet setup unrelated to the current stack.

pstack:no-comments.reason: Broad comment deletion and Comment Sicko coupling are too aggressive for a default cross-repository workflow.

pstack:poteto-help.reason: The personal README and routing table describe the combined stack instead.

pstack:poteto-mode.reason: A sticky Cursor mode would compete with Son's instructions and the combined task-specific workflows.

pstack:principle-build-the-lever.reason: Repeatable commands and evidence are part of the shared rules and verification workflow.

pstack:principle-guard-the-context-windo.reason: Load relevant evidence selectively; do not make delegation mandatory when it is unavailable or unauthorized.

pstack:principle-laziness-protocol.reason: The existing preference for the smallest sufficient change owns this behavior.

pstack:principle-migrate-callers-then-de.reason: Useful for internal migrations, but public compatibility and caller scope must be established first.

pstack:principle-minimize-reader-load.reason: Concise interfaces, explanations, and instructions are covered by the combined workflows.

pstack:principle-never-block-on-the-huma.reason: Son's existing authority and autonomy rules already govern reversible work and material decisions.

pstack:principle-outcome-oriented-execut.reason: Keep the target outcome, but do not import permission for broken intermediate states into every repository.

pstack:principle-redesign-from-first-pri.reason: Revisit repeated failed assumptions within the authorized scope; a symptom does not authorize a broad rewrite.

pstack:principle-subtract-before-you-add.reason: Simplify within task scope; do not delete unrelated code merely because it appears unused.

pstack:setup-pstack.reason: Do not write an always-applied Cursor model rule over Son's canonical model policy.

pstack:swarm.reason: Delegation is an optional execution method under active authorization, not a default skill dependency.

emil:pick-ui-library.reason: Useful opinionated shortlist, but package selection must check current official docs and existing dependencies; no automatic installs.

matt:ask-matt.reason: The personal routing table spans all four creators and replaces the Matt-only router.

matt:setup-matt-pocock-skills.reason: The personal setup guide reuses real tracker conventions and permits local specs without invented labels.

matt:triage.reason: Tracker roles, triage states, and labels need per-project configuration before activation.

matt:wizard.reason: Keep for genuinely human-only provisioning steps; routine automation should use available tools directly.

matt:chief-of-staff.reason: Upstream in-progress skill; long-running multi-agent orchestration needs separate authority and evaluation.

matt:claude-handoff.reason: Upstream in-progress skill; Son's existing cross-harness handoff protocol owns continuation.

matt:loop-me.reason: Upstream in-progress skill; use the bounded combined automation workflow for now.

matt:setup-ts-deep-modules.reason: Upstream in-progress dependency-cruiser setup changes repository tooling and needs a project-specific decision.

matt:writing-beats.reason: Upstream in-progress long-form writing workflow; not part of the initial engineering and decision stack.

matt:writing-fragments.reason: Upstream in-progress writing exploration; retain for a later writing-focused evaluation.

matt:writing-shape.reason: Upstream in-progress article shaping; retain for a later writing-focused evaluation.

matt:git-guardrails-claude-code.reason: Claude-specific hooks should be reconciled with the existing canonical safety configuration before installation.

matt:migrate-to-shoehorn.reason: Narrow dependency-specific migration, useful only in a repository that adopts shoehorn.

matt:scaffold-exercises.reason: Course exercise scaffolding is a separate specialist workflow rather than a default engineering skill.

matt:setup-pre-commit.reason: Husky and lint-staged setup must fit the actual package manager and existing checks; no global dependency policy.
